basic_details.job_title: MTNL property Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL) will engage 01 (one) retired officer as property Consultant in MTNL Delhi on a short-term contract, initially for six months. The post is only for applicants who retired from Group 'A' services of a CPSE or Government Department with land experience, or from the post of DGM and above (regular E-6 or above)/JAG. The consolidated fee is the difference between last pay drawn plus DA and Pension plus DA, or Rs.51,000/-, whichever is less. Applications go in the prescribed Bio-Data format by post to Janpath, New Delhi, with a scanned copy by email, by 27 Nov

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 65 years as on the last date for submission of application (27 November 2026). The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed Bio-Data format attached to the notice: post applied for, name, address for communication, mobile number, e-mail ID, date of birth/category, date of retirement/grade, age, educational and professional qualification, and previous employment in chronological order.
Paste a latest passport size photo (self attested) on the form, and attach a separate sheet for the employment details if required.
Sign the declaration and list the enclosures.
Send the application in physical form to: Dy. Manager (R&E), Philatic Hall, Badminton Court, Eastern Court Compound, Janpath, New Delhi - 110001.
Also send a scanned copy of the application with all annexures (if any) to [email protected]. The notice says this email is mandatory.
The notice does not mention an application fee.

content_sections.heading: About MTNL property Consultant
content_sections.text: According to the notice, Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited is a Navratna PSU under the Ministry of Telecommunication, providing a wide array of Telecom and IT services in the metro cities of Delhi and Mumbai. The property Consultant will work in MTNL Delhi and is expected to bring knowledge of prevailing land laws/ rules of costing, disposal, planning/ engineering of land management. The engagement is made under MTNL's Terms of Engagement (Annexure-II), "as per Company policy as amended from time to time".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice is open only to retired officers. An applicant must meet one of the two options below. Option 1: The applicant should have retired from Group 'A' services of any CPSE/ Government Department, preferably from DDA/ L&DO/ Noida Authority, having minimum three years experience & expertise in dealing with land, planning, engineering, and is supposed to coordinate with DDA, L&DO, MCD, DUSIB, Delhi Government, DSIIDC, Gram panchayt, Noida Authority in land matters. OR Option 2: The applicant should have retired from PSU/Autonomous body/ Govt. from the post of DGM and above (regular E-6 or above)/JAG, having mandatory expertise for the job. Retirement from DDA, L&DO or Noida Authority is a preference under Option 1, not a requirement. The three-year land experience condition is printed under Option 1; Option 2 asks for "mandatory expertise for the job". The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The Bio-Data form asks for educational and professional qualification, date of retirement and grade, and last pay drawn. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post. The maximum age limit is 65 years as on the last date for submission of application (27 November 2026). The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consolidated fee: the difference between last pay drawn plus DA and Pension plus DA, or a lumpsum amount of Rs.51,000/-, whichever is less. Mobile: CMD, MTNL has power to consider a special request for mobile for discharge of official duties. No other charges: no other charges shall be admissible. Tax: Income Tax or any other tax liable to be deducted under prevailing rules will be deducted at source, and MTNL will issue a TDS certificate. Leave: Casual Leave on pro-rata basis is admissible for the period of contract, up to a maximum of 12 in a year. Tenure: purely on a short term contract basis, initially for six months, which can be further extended based on requirement and performance. Either party may terminate the consultancy/contract by giving 30 days prior written notice.

content_sections.heading: MTNL property Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: The scope of work printed in the notice is to handle asset monetization related work in the Company and handling/ liaisoning for land disposal related matters, as under: Resolving issues pertaining to property documents/ monetization with various local bodies like DDA, L&DO, MCD, DUSIB, Delhi Government, DSIIDC, Gram panchayt, Noida Authority etc.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MTNL property Consultant
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed Bio-Data format attached to the notice: post applied for, name, address for communication, mobile number, e-mail ID, date of birth/category, date of retirement/grade, age, educational and professional qualification, and previous employment in chronological order. Paste a latest passport size photo (self attested) on the form, and attach a separate sheet for the employment details if required. Sign the declaration and list the enclosures. Send the application in physical form to: Dy. Manager (R&E), Philatic Hall, Badminton Court, Eastern Court Compound, Janpath, New Delhi - 110001. Also send a scanned copy of the application with all annexures (if any) to [email protected] . The notice says this email is mandatory. Complete both by 27 November 2026, 5:00 PM. The notice does not mention an application fee. Application in the prescribed Bio-Data format Latest passport size photo, self attested Separate sheet for previous employment/experience, if required All annexures (if any) with the scanned copy

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection shall be based on the qualifications/ experience, on the recommendation of a committee to be constituted for the purpose. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MTNL property Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MTNL intends to engage 01 (one) experienced individual as property Consultant in MTNL Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MTNL property Consultant post?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 27 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for the MTNL property Consultant post?
faq.answer: Retired Group 'A' officers of any CPSE/Government Department (preferably DDA/ L&DO/ Noida Authority) with minimum three years land, planning and engineering experience, or officers retired from PSU/Autonomous body/Govt. as DGM and above (regular E-6 or above)/JAG with mandatory expertise for the job.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MTNL property Consultant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 65 years as on the last date for submission of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the MTNL property Consultant?
faq.answer: The consolidated fee is the difference between last pay drawn plus DA and Pension plus DA, or a lumpsum amount of Rs.51,000/-, whichever is less.

faq.question: Q6. Are HRA or other allowances paid on top of the consolidated fee?
faq.answer: No other charges shall be admissible, as the notice states. CMD, MTNL has power to consider a special request for mobile for discharge of official duties.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the MTNL property Consultant post?
faq.answer: Send the Bio-Data application in physical form to Dy. Manager (R&E), Philatic Hall, Badminton Court, Eastern Court Compound, Janpath, New Delhi - 110001, and mandatorily email a scanned copy with all annexures to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. How will the MTNL property Consultant be selected?
faq.answer: Selection shall be based on qualifications/experience on the recommendation of a committee to be constituted for the purpose.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MTNL property Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely a short term contract, initially for six months, which can be extended based on requirement and performance; either party may end it with 30 days prior written notice.

faq.question: Q10. Can retired employees apply, and how is their pay fixed?
faq.answer: Only retired officers can apply. Their consolidated fee is the difference between last pay drawn plus DA and Pension plus DA, capped at Rs.51,000/- (whichever is less).
